Players Committee card image of [[Elis In Hinthra (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “May add 1 pilot and 3 passengers. Permanent pilot is •Elis, who provides ability of 2. Once per game, may use 1 Force to deploy a smuggler aboard from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 5.”
